sn34.16:1.5: One meditator is skilled in projecting the mind purified by immersion but not in entering it.
sn34.16:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in entering immersion nor in projecting the mind purified by it.
sn34.16:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in entering immersion and in projecting the mind purified by it.
